comment: The two REVERSE jacks are numbered the other way round from the way they sit on the panel: index 66, named Reverese Live Grains, is the right-hand jack and index 67, Reverse Sample Grains, the left-hand one. The README describes them left to right, “the first for samples, the second for live inputs”, and that agrees with the panel; the code settles it at GrainsOfWrath.cpp:678 and 695, where the samples jack is read per sample slot and the live jack per live voice. Thirty-one inputs, a reset input, two parameters and a third output are declared with no widget on the panel and are left untagged; the reset input is never read in process either. A monophonic cable in FREEZE or either REVERSE jack acts on every voice at once, because the code only indexes by voice when the cable carries more than one channel. The two V/OCT inputs match a volt per octave only at one volt either side of zero; past that the code adds the voltage to a rate multiplier rather than scaling exponentially.
